caption:
Training lower body like an athlete!

Here’s how I build stronger, more powerful legs, using a mix of power, isolation, and functional work for each major muscle group (in order of the video: hamstrings, quads, and glutes)

And of course, we also train raw strength with the classics:
✔️Deadlifts for hamstrings
✔️Squats for quads
✔️Hip thrusts for glutes

Because if you want to move and perform like an athlete, you need to combine power, strength, and function - not just one or the other 🔥

Develop glutes with hip thrusts combined with power and functional work
